# UltraTextGen — Updates

> What changed, and why it matters for your text. UltraTextGen tracks new Unicode versions, platform formatting changes, and game nickname rule changes: the same events that keep our Check tools accurate.

## Updates

- [Updates](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/): New Unicode versions, platform formatting changes and game nickname rules, each one dated.
- [Forza Horizon 6: Gamertag and Driver Name Split](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/forza-horizon-6-gamertag-rules/): Forza Horizon 6 shows you two names.
- [Liên Quân Mobile Tightens Rename Locks for Invalid Names](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/lienquan-mobile-name-penalty-update/): Since January 1, 2026, an invalid character name or avatar in Liên Quân Mobile is corrected by the system automatically, and your rename…
- [Middle East Currency Symbols: 5 Have Their Own, 10 Don't](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/middle-east-currency-symbols-scorecard/): Five currencies in the region have a Unicode sign that belongs to them alone.
- [Omani Rial Symbol: Final in Unicode 18.0, Font Rollout Status](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/omani-rial-symbol-unicode-18/): Oman announced its rial sign in November 2025, and the Unicode Technical Committee gave it a permanent code nine weeks later.
- [Telegram Premium Messages Grow From 4,096 to 32,768 Characters](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/telegram-premium-message-limit/): Telegram now has two message limits.
- [UAE Dirham Symbol: Final in Unicode 18.0, Keyboard Rollout Status](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/uae-dirham-symbol-unicode-18/): The UAE's new dirham symbol became part of the Unicode standard on September 16, 2026.
- [Unicode 17.0's New Emoji: Where They Work Right Now](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/unicode-17-new-emoji-rollout/): The eight emoji Unicode added in September 2025 now render on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Samsung phones and WhatsApp.
- [What's New in Unicode 18.0: 13,007 Characters, Nearly All Historical](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/unicode-18-beta-review-opens/): Unicode 18.0 published on September 16, 2026 with 13,007 new characters: three historical scripts, three currency symbols, 145 maths and…
- [Unicode 18.0's New Emoji: Cracking Face Wins the Public Vote](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/unicode-18-most-anticipated-emoji/): Nine emoji were approved on July 30, 2026 and published with Unicode 18.0 on September 16, 2026.
- [Unicode 18.0 Was Published on September 16, 2026, and One Script Was Cut](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/unicode-18-release-date-confirmed/): Unicode 18.0 was published on September 16, 2026, as scheduled.
- [WhatsApp Usernames: The New @Handle Rules, Explained](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/whatsapp-usernames-rollout/): A WhatsApp @username is 3 to 35 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, periods and underscores, with at least one letter somewhere.
- [Xbox Gamertags Grow From 12 to 15 Characters](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/xbox-gamertag-15-character-limit/): An Xbox Gamertag can now be 15 characters long.
